content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] and would like to know if it's possible to connect a digital temperature sensor like the DS18B20 to its digital input, or if a PT100 sensor can be connected to its analog input.

The DS18B20 uses a '1 wire' bus output, which is suitable for platforms like Arduino but not for [product_name] inputs. A PT100 or PT1000 sensor should not be connected directly to a 0-10V analog input via a voltage divider. It's best to use a PT100 or PT1000 converter for this type of connection.
Thank you, so the only solution would be to use an external module or a 0-10V adapter. [url]

That's heading in the right direction. Just make sure to select a measuring range that fits your needs. Avoid using a 0-600°C range unless necessary. Maybe something like -30°C to 70°C is more suitable, depending on your application.

So, to confirm, the [product_name] analog inputs only accept 0-10V voltage signals, not 0-20mA current signals? Does the [product_name] series have significant advantages for connecting temperature sensors? Thank you.

The analog inputs on the basic modules of [product_name] only process 0-10V voltage signals, not current signals. If you want to use a 4-20mA signal on the analog inputs, you’ll need to either use an external transmitter that converts 4-20mA to 0-10V, or use a 500-ohm precision resistor (1% tolerance, minimum 0.5 watts) as a load to convert the current into a 2-10V voltage drop, which the analog input can then read.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users want to connect temperature sensors to the analog inputs of a [product_name] module and are unsure about the compatibility with digital sensors like DS18B20, as well as the supported signal types (voltage vs. current) for the analog inputs. There is a recognized limitation since the inputs only accept voltage signals (0–10V), not current (4–20mA), so external modules or adapters are needed for wider sensor compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to connect common temperature sensors directly to the analog inputs of the [product_name] module without needing much extra equipment or complex signal conversions.
